general: Equipment quality cannot exceed weapon quality. Only published tiers and slot capacities are used; missing data stays unverified.
Category tags describe the source's supported classes and technologies. Planning also requires positive individual compatibility and a real matching slot.
The planner remains freely editable and never changes base weapon statistics or the player's game save.
conventional: Conventional weapon mods are normally permanent once installed in the game. x-MOD2 replacement is a documented exception.
chimera: Chimera mods can be removed. Crafting consumes the single Active Chimera Core, so one normal-playthrough configuration can use only one core-crafted choice.
attachment: Attachments are generally removable, but some iconic sights and muzzles are fixed. The individual weapon checks block fixed equipment and unverified replacement.
Sniper rifles require a scope in game. An empty planner slot means the choice is undecided; it does not simulate removing a required scope.
otherIconic: This iconic mod is not one of the four Chimera-core choices. Chimera removal rules are not assumed; consult the item's sources for installation behavior.
